# Andrea Salami

> Andrea Salami is a web developer based in Cremona, Italy, studying for a Master's Degree in Blockchain at Start2Impact University and vice president of the Amici di Agropolis association, a non-profit that promotes social inclusion.

This is Andrea Salami's personal website (https://andreasalami.github.io/). It is written in English. Andrea speaks Italian (native) and English (B2, FCE).

- Skills: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, Python, Git, Solidity and Ethereum smart contracts.
- Work: copywriter on blockchain and technical topics (Syntralink, 2024–2025; Blockchain Solutions Italy, 2023), on-board courier (Modus Operations, 2021–2023), management-control clerk at Comune di Cremona.
- Volunteering: long-time volunteer at Agropolis, board member of the Amici di Agropolis association since 2020 and vice president since 2025; organiser of L'Agro ai Giovani, the largest charity festival in Cremona, since 2018.

## Pages

- [Home](https://andreasalami.github.io/): bio, coding skills, projects, volunteering and hobbies
- [Curriculum vitae](https://andreasalami.github.io/curriculum.html): work experience, education, volunteering, languages and skills
- [Contact](https://andreasalami.github.io/form.html): contact form

## Projects

- [LAG – L'Agro ai Giovani app](https://andreasalami.github.io/lag_app/): mobile-first web app for the charity festival (React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase). Source: https://github.com/andreasalami/lag_app
- [Counter App](https://andreasalami.github.io/counter-appJS/): split-screen counter with persistent memory (HTML, CSS, JavaScript). Source: https://github.com/andreasalami/counter-appJS
- [Crypto Report](https://github.com/andreasalami/Python_Project_Crypto_Report): Python tool that builds a crypto market report from CoinMarketCap API data
